```{r transfer MG label}
# Identify overlapping cell barcodes between the two objects
mg_cells <- intersect(colnames(microglia), colnames(merge_obj_filtered))

# Update cell_type annotation in merge_obj_filtered for overlapping cells
merge_obj_filtered$annotation2 <- merge_obj_filtered$annotation
merge_obj_filtered$annotation2 <- as.character(merge_obj_filtered$annotation2)
merge_obj_filtered$annotation2[colnames(merge_obj_filtered) %in% mg_cells] <- "Microglia"
```

```{r}
library(circlize)
library(dendextend)
library(stringr)
```


```{r circle plot}
sample_annot <- data.frame(
  TimePoint = rep("Chronic", ncol(exp_mat)),
  COndition = rep("Disease", ncol(exp_mat)),
  CellType  = rep("Unknown", ncol(exp_mat)),
  CellCount = as.vector(cell_count[gsub("-", "_", colnames(exp_mat))]),
  Dataset   = "VEEV"
)
rownames(sample_annot) <- colnames(exp_mat)

sample_annot$TimePoint[grep("7d|24h",            rownames(sample_annot))] <- "Acute"
sample_annot$COndition[grep("Control|Mock|Sham",  rownames(sample_annot))] <- "Control"
# 1. Create the CellType column by joining the 4th and 5th elements
sample_annot$CellType <- paste(
  str_split(rownames(sample_annot), "-", simplify = TRUE)[, 4],
  str_split(rownames(sample_annot), "-", simplify = TRUE)[, 5],
  sep = "_"
)
# 2. Remove the trailing underscore using a regular expression
# '$' matches the end of the string
sample_annot$CellType <- str_remove(sample_annot$CellType, "_$")


sample_annot$Dataset[grep("TBI",  rownames(sample_annot))] <- "TBI"
sample_annot$Dataset[grep("OPNA", rownames(sample_annot))] <- "OPNA"

# Fix any remaining NA CellCounts
sample_annot$CellCount[is.na(sample_annot$CellCount)] <- 0

marker_list <- c()
for (i in unique(markers$cluster)) {
  tmp <- markers[which(markers$cluster == i), ]
  marker_list <- c(marker_list, tmp$gene[1:50])
}

# Clustering — exp_mat now has exactly ncol = nrow(sample_annot)
sample_dist    <- dist(1 - cor(exp_mat[unique(marker_list), ]), method = "euclidean")
sample_cluster <- hclust(sample_dist, method = "ward.D2")
dend           <- as.dendrogram(sample_cluster)
max_height     <- attr(dend, "height")

sample_order         <- order.dendrogram(dend)
sample_annot_ordered <- sample_annot[sample_order, ]

n <- nrow(sample_annot_ordered)

# ── Colors ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
colors_time <- c(
  "Acute"   = "#0072B2",
  "Chronic" = "#E69F00"
)

colors_disease <- c(
  "Control" = "#b1a9e5",
  "Disease" = "#6A5ACD"
)

# extract the color to make it consitent with the Dimplot
colors_celltype <- c(
  "Astrocytes"       = "#A3A500",
  "Excitatory_Neurons"       = "#F8766D",
  "Inhibitory_Neurons"       = "#39B600",
  "Oligodendrocytes" = "#D89000",
  "OPCs"             = "#9590FF",
  "Myeloid"          = "#E76BF3",
  "Lymphoid"         = "#FF62BC",
  "Microglia"        = "#00BF7D",
  "VLMC"      = "#00B0F6",
  "Endothelial_Cells"         = "#00BFC4"
)

colors_dataset <- c(
  "VEEV" = "#CD5C5C",
  "TBI" = "#5b94cd",
  "OPNA" = "#5bcd94"
)
pdf("circos_plot.pdf", width = 12, height = 12)

# ── Circos ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
circos.clear()
circos.par(
  start.degree = 0,
  gap.after    = 60,
  cell.padding = c(0, 0, 0, 0)
)
circos.initialize(factors = "a", xlim = c(0, n))

max_count <- max(sample_annot_ordered$CellCount, na.rm = TRUE)

# 1️⃣ Cell count bars
circos.track(ylim = c(0, max_count), panel.fun = function(x, y) {
  for (i in 1:n) {
    value <- sample_annot_ordered$CellCount[i]
    if (is.na(value)) value <- 0
    circos.rect(i - 0.8, 0, i - 0.2, value, col = "#69b3a2", border = NA)
  }
}, track.height = 0.15, bg.border = NA)

# 2️⃣ Cell type
circos.track(ylim = c(0, 1), panel.fun = function(x, y) {
  for (i in 1:n) {
    circos.rect(i - 1, 0, i, 1,
                col    = colors_celltype[as.character(sample_annot_ordered$CellType[i])],
                border = "black")
  }
}, track.height = 0.06, bg.border = NA)

# 3️⃣ Dataset
circos.track(ylim = c(0, 1), panel.fun = function(x, y) {
  for (i in 1:n) {
    circos.rect(i - 1, 0, i, 1,
                col    = colors_dataset[as.character(sample_annot_ordered$Dataset[i])],
                border = "black")
  }
}, track.height = 0.06, bg.border = NA)

# 4️⃣ Disease
circos.track(ylim = c(0, 1), panel.fun = function(x, y) {
  for (i in 1:n) {
    circos.rect(i - 1, 0, i, 1,
                col    = colors_disease[as.character(sample_annot_ordered$COndition[i])],
                border = "black")
  }
}, track.height = 0.06, bg.border = NA)

# 5️⃣ Time point
circos.track(ylim = c(0, 1), panel.fun = function(x, y) {
  for (i in 1:n) {
    circos.rect(i - 1, 0, i, 1,
                col    = colors_time[as.character(sample_annot_ordered$TimePoint[i])],
                border = "black")
  }
}, track.height = 0.06, bg.border = NA)

# 6️⃣ Dendrogram (innermost)
circos.track(
  ylim         = c(0, max_height),
  track.height = 0.45,
  bg.border    = NA,
  panel.fun    = function(x, y) {
    circos.dendrogram(dend, facing = "outside",
                      max_height = max_height, use_x_attr = FALSE)
  }
)

# ── Legends ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend("bottomleft",  legend = names(colors_time),     fill = colors_time,
       title = "Time Point", cex = 0.8, bty = "n")
legend("topright",    legend = names(colors_disease),  fill = colors_disease,
       title = "Disease",    cex = 0.8, bty = "n")
legend("bottomright", legend = names(colors_celltype), fill = colors_celltype,
       title = "Cell Type",  cex = 0.8, bty = "n")
legend("topleft",     legend = names(colors_dataset),  fill = colors_dataset,
       title = "Dataset",    cex = 0.8, bty = "n")

circos.clear()
dev.off()
```

####################################################################
# Differential Abundance
####################################################################

```{r}
library(miloR)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scater)
library(scran)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
```



```{r}
meta <- merge_obj_filtered@meta.data
meta$Dataset   <- sub("_.*", "", meta$orig.ident)
meta$Condition <- sapply(strsplit(meta$orig.ident, "_"), `[`, 2)
meta$TimePoint <- sapply(strsplit(meta$orig.ident, "_"), `[`, 3)
meta$Phase <- ifelse(meta$TimePoint %in% c("24h", "7d"), "Acute", "Chronic")
meta$Group <- ifelse(
  meta$Condition %in% c("Control", "Sham", "Mock"), "Control", "Treated"
)
merge_obj_filtered@meta.data <- meta

merge_obj_filtered$miloR <- merge_obj_filtered$orig.ident
merge_obj_filtered$miloR[which(merge_obj_filtered$Group == "Control")] <- "Control"
merge_obj_filtered$miloR <- paste0(merge_obj_filtered$miloR, 1:2)
```



```{r}
result <- list(Acute = list(), Chronic = list())
object <- list(Acute = list(), Chronic = list())

for (i in c("Acute", "Chronic")) {
  for (j in c("VEEV", "TBI", "OPNA")) {
    cat(i, j, "\n")
    
    sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(
      merge_obj_filtered[, which(merge_obj_filtered$Phase == i & merge_obj_filtered$Dataset == j)]
    )
    
    sce <- logNormCounts(sce)
    
    milo_obj <- Milo(sce)
    
    milo_obj <- buildGraph(milo_obj, k = 30, d = 30, reduced.dim = "HARMONY")
    
    milo_obj <- makeNhoods(milo_obj, prop = 0.1, k = 30, d = 30, refined = TRUE,
                           reduced_dims = "HARMONY")
    
    plotNhoodSizeHist(milo_obj)
    
    milo_obj <- countCells(milo_obj, meta.data = data.frame(colData(milo_obj)),
                           samples = "miloR")
    
    # Define experimental design
    design <- as.data.frame(xtabs(~ Group + miloR, data = data.frame(colData(milo_obj))))
    design <- design[design$Freq > 0, ]
    rownames(design) <- design$miloR
    design <- design[colnames(nhoodCounts(milo_obj)), ]
    
    milo.res <- testNhoods(milo_obj, design = ~Group, design.df = design)
    
    milo.res <- annotateNhoods(milo_obj, milo.res, coldata_col = "annotation2_refined")
    
    result[[i]][[j]] <- milo.res
    object[[i]][[j]] <- milo_obj
    
    pdf(paste(i, j, ".pdf", sep = "_"))
    p <- plotDAbeeswarm(milo.res, group.by = "annotation2_refined")
    print(p)
    dev.off()
  }
}

save(result, object, file = "Result.Rdata")
# save(result, file = "plot.data.Rdata") # an older version is stored here
```

```{r}
plot_data <- list(Acute = list(), Chronic = list())
fig <- plot_data

for (i in names(result)) {
  for (j in names(result[[1]])) {
    cat(i, j, "\n")
    
    df <- as.data.frame(result[[i]][[j]])
    df <- df[!df$annotation2_refined %in% c("Lymphoid","Myeloid"),]
    
    plot_data[[i]][[j]] <- df
    
    ave <- tapply(plot_data[[i]][[j]]$logFC, plot_data[[i]][[j]]$annotation2_refined, median)
    
    plot_data[[i]][[j]]$annotation2_refined <- factor(
      plot_data[[i]][[j]]$annotation2_refined,
      levels = names(sort(ave))
    )
    
    fig[[i]][[j]] <- ggplot(plot_data[[i]][[j]], aes(x = annotation2_refined, y = logFC)) +
      geom_quasirandom(aes(color = logFC),
                       size = 0.8, alpha = 1, width = 0.6) +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, alpha = 1, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_color_gradient2(
        low = "#bd3030",
        mid = "grey90",
        high = "#483d8b",
        midpoint = 0,
        name = "LogFC"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste(i, j),
        x = "",
        y = "Log Fold Change"
      ) +
      theme(
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey90"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        legend.position = "none"
      )
  }
}

  ncol = 3
))
dev.off()
```

```{r}
plot_data <- list(Acute = list(), Chronic = list())
fig <- plot_data

celltype_abbrev <- c(
  "Astrocytes"           = "AST",
  "Excitatory_Neurons"   = "EXC",
  "Inhibitory_Neurons"   = "INH",
  "Oligodendrocytes"     = "OD",
  "OPCs"                 = "OPC",
  "Microglia"            = "MG",
  "Vascular_Cells"       = "END",
  "Fibroblasts"          = "VLMC"
)

plot_data <- list(Acute = list(), Chronic = list())
fig <- plot_data

for (i in names(result)) {
  for (j in names(result[[i]])) {
    cat(i, j, "\n")
    
    df <- as.data.frame(result[[i]][[j]])
    
    # remove unwanted populations before abbreviation
    df <- df[!df$annotation2 %in% c("Lymphoid", "Myeloid"), ]
    
    # replace annotation2 with abbreviated names
    df$annotation2 <- as.character(df$annotation2)
    idx <- df$annotation2 %in% names(celltype_abbrev)
    df$annotation2[idx] <- celltype_abbrev[df$annotation2[idx]]
    
    # store data
    plot_data[[i]][[j]] <- df
    
    # order cell types by median logFC
    ave <- tapply(
      plot_data[[i]][[j]]$logFC,
      plot_data[[i]][[j]]$annotation2,
      median,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    celltype_order <- names(sort(ave))
    
    plot_data[[i]][[j]]$annotation2 <- factor(
      plot_data[[i]][[j]]$annotation2,
      levels = celltype_order
    )
    
    # plot
    fig[[i]][[j]] <- ggplot(
  plot_data[[i]][[j]],
  aes(x = annotation2, y = logFC)
) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    aes(color = logFC),
    size = 0.8,
    alpha = 1,
    width = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.5,
    alpha = 1,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#bd3030",
    mid = "grey90",
    high = "#483d8b",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "LogFC"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(i, j),
    x = "",
    y = "Log Fold Change"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 22
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 20,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 20,
      color = "black"

    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 25, color = "black"),
```

```{r}
meta <- merge_obj_filtered@meta.data
meta$Dataset   <- sub("_.*", "", meta$orig.ident)

meta$Group <- ifelse(
  meta$Condition %in% c("Control", "Sham", "Mock"), "Control", "Treated"
)
merge_obj_filtered@meta.data <- meta

merge_obj_filtered$class <- merge_obj_filtered$Dataset
# merge_obj_filtered$class[which(merge_obj_filtered$Group == "Control")] <- "Control"

celltype_order <- c(

)

# group_colors <- c("#CD5C5C", "#5b94cd", "#5bcd94", "#b1a9e5")
group_colors <- c("#CD5C5C", "#5b94cd", "#5bcd94")

# Plot cell number
dat_num <- table(merge_obj_filtered$class, merge_obj_filtered$annotation2_refined)
plot.data <- melt(t(dat_num))
plot.data$value <- plot.data$value / 1e4  # ← divide by 10^4
# plot.data$Var2 <- factor(plot.data$Var2, levels = c("VEEV", "TBI", "OPNA", "Control"))

plot.data <- plot.data[!plot.data$Var1 %in% c("Myeloid", "Lymphoid"),]

p1 <- ggplot(plot.data, aes(x = Var1, y = value, fill = Var2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  xlab("") + ylab(expression("Number of cells (" %*% 10^4 ~ ")")) +  # ← updated label
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = group_colors)

# Plot cell fraction
dat_frac <- as.data.frame(table(merge_obj_filtered$class, merge_obj_filtered$annotation2_refined))
count <- tapply(dat_frac$Freq, dat_frac$Var2, sum)
dat_frac$fraction <- dat_frac$Freq / rep(count, each = 3)
# dat_frac$Var1 <- factor(dat_frac$Var1, levels = c("VEEV", "TBI", "OPNA", "Control"))
dat_frac$Var1 <- factor(dat_frac$Var1, levels = c("VEEV", "TBI", "OPNA"))
dat_frac$Var2 <- factor(dat_frac$Var2, levels = celltype_order)

dat_frac <- dat_frac[!dat_frac$Var2 %in% c("Myeloid", "Lymphoid"),]

p2 <- ggplot(dat_frac, aes(x = Var2, y = fraction, fill = Var1)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  xlab("") + ylab("Fraction of cells") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = group_colors)

pdf("Fig2_cell.number.and.fraction.pdf", width = 16, height = 7)
print(cowplot::plot_grid(p2, p1, ncol = 2))
dev.off()
```




```{r}
## -------------------------------
## Plot cell-type proportion normalized within each dataset
## -------------------------------

dat_prop <- as.data.frame(
  table(
    merge_obj_filtered$class,
    merge_obj_filtered$annotation2_refined
  )
)

colnames(dat_prop) <- c("Dataset", "Celltype", "Freq")

## factor order
dat_prop$Dataset <- factor(dat_prop$Dataset, levels = c("VEEV", "TBI", "OPNA"))
dat_prop$Celltype <- factor(dat_prop$Celltype, levels = celltype_order)

## denominator: total cells within each dataset
dataset_total <- tapply(dat_prop$Freq, dat_prop$Dataset, sum)

dat_prop$dataset_total <- dataset_total[as.character(dat_prop$Dataset)]

dat_prop$fraction_within_dataset <- dat_prop$Freq / dat_prop$dataset_total

## remove unwanted cell types after normalization
dat_prop <- dat_prop[!dat_prop$Celltype %in% c("Myeloid", "Lymphoid"), ]

p3 <- ggplot(
  dat_prop,
  aes(x = Celltype, y = fraction_within_dataset, fill = Dataset)
) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("Fraction within each dataset") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 13,
      angle = 45,
      vjust = 1,
      hjust = 1,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = group_colors)

p3
```




```{r}
## -------------------------------
## P4: fraction-of-normalized-proportions
## First normalize within each dataset, then stack/percentage across datasets
## -------------------------------

## dat_prop should already contain:
## Dataset, Celltype, Freq, dataset_total, fraction_within_dataset

dat_p4 <- dat_prop

## For each cell type, calculate the total normalized proportion across datasets
celltype_total_prop <- tapply(
  dat_p4$fraction_within_dataset,
  dat_p4$Celltype,
  sum,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

dat_p4$celltype_total_prop <- celltype_total_prop[as.character(dat_p4$Celltype)]

## Now calculate fraction of proportions
dat_p4$fraction_of_proportions <- dat_p4$fraction_within_dataset / dat_p4$celltype_total_prop

## keep factor order
dat_p4$Dataset <- factor(dat_p4$Dataset, levels = c("VEEV", "TBI", "OPNA"))
dat_p4$Celltype <- factor(dat_p4$Celltype, levels = celltype_order)

## remove unwanted cell types if not already removed
dat_p4 <- dat_p4[!dat_p4$Celltype %in% c("Myeloid", "Lymphoid"), ]

p4 <- ggplot(
  dat_p4,
  aes(x = Celltype, y = fraction_of_proportions, fill = Dataset)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("Fraction of normalized proportions") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 13,
      angle = 45,
      vjust = 1,
      hjust = 1,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = group_colors)

p4
```


```{r}
pdf(
  "Fig2_cell.number.fraction.dataset.normalized.and.normalized.stack.pdf",
  width = 16,
  height = 14
)

print(
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    p1, p2,
    p3, p4,
    ncol = 2,
    labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
    label_size = 18
  )
)

dev.off()
```
